description: Create Layer 3 Quality and Performance Agent Workflows with supporting config. Includes quality gates, performance regression detection, uptime monitoring, and accuracy reporting.
steps: Create .github/workflows/agent-quality-gate.yml: triggers on pull_request and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout, (2) Setup Python 3.11, install ruff + radon + vulture, (3) Setup Node 22 + pnpm, install deps, (4) Run pytest --cov on backend and fail if coverage drops below 60% (use coverage threshold), (5) Run radon cc on apps/backend/app/ and fail if any function has cyclomatic complexity > 10, (6) Run vulture for dead code detection on backend, (7) Build frontend (pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit build) and check bundle size against baseline from performance-baseline.json, (8) Comment results on PR. Permissions: contents read + pull-requests write. Concurrency: quality-${{ github.ref }}

Create .github/workflows/agent-performance-regression.yml: triggers on pull_request (branches: main) and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout, (2) Setup Node 22 + pnpm + install deps, (3) Build frontend, (4) Install and run @lhci/cli (Lighthouse CI) against built frontend with basic static server, (5) Compare LCP/TBT/CLS against thresholds in performance-baseline.json, (6) Comment performance diff summary on PR, (7) Fail if LCP increases > 500ms or TBT increases > 100ms or bundle size increases > 10%. Permissions: contents read + pull-requests write

Create .github/workflows/agent-uptime-monitor.yml: triggers on schedule (every 15 min cron: '*/15 * * * *') and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout to get uptime script, (2) Run scripts/uptime-check.sh, (3) If exit code 1 (endpoint down): check if open issue with 'incident' label exists, if not create one with timestamp + failed endpoints, (4) If exit code 0 (all healthy): check if open 'incident' issue exists, if yes close it with recovery comment and duration, (5) Dispatch repository_dispatch event 'endpoint-down' for external alerting. Permissions: issues write + contents read

Create .github/workflows/agent-accuracy-report.yml: triggers on schedule (daily cron: '0 8 * * *') and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout, (2) Setup Node for mongosh, (3) Run scripts/accuracy-report.js via mongosh using MONGODB_URI secret, (4) Parse output for overall satisfaction percentage, (5) If satisfaction < 85%, create/update a pinned issue with 'accuracy-alert' label, (6) Always update a 'daily-accuracy-report' issue with latest stats (find existing or create). Permissions: issues write + contents read. Note: uses secrets.MONGODB_URI
acceptance_criteria: All 4 workflow YAML files exist with valid syntax
agent-quality-gate.yml runs coverage, complexity, dead code, and bundle size checks
agent-performance-regression.yml uses Lighthouse CI and compares against baseline
agent-uptime-monitor.yml calls existing scripts/uptime-check.sh and manages incident issues
agent-accuracy-report.yml calls existing scripts/accuracy-report.js via mongosh
All workflows include workflow_dispatch, concurrency groups, and permissions blocks
verification: Run: python3 -c "import yaml; [yaml.safe_load(open(f)) for f in __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-quality*.yml') + __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-performance*.yml') + __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-uptime*.yml') + __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-accuracy*.yml')]" to validate YAML
Run: python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('.github/scripts/performance-baseline.json'))" to validate JSON
Run: grep 'uptime-check.sh' .github/workflows/agent-uptime-monitor.yml to confirm script integration
Run: grep 'accuracy-report.js' .github/workflows/agent-accuracy-report.yml to confirm script integration
findings: All 5 files created successfully. YAML validation passes for all 4 workflows. JSON validation passes for performance-baseline.json. All workflows have workflow_dispatch, concurrency groups, permissions blocks, and pinned action versions (@v6 for checkout/setup-node/setup-python, @v7 for github-script). agent-quality-gate.yml has separate jobs for backend-quality, frontend-quality, and comment-results. agent-uptime-monitor.yml integrates scripts/uptime-check.sh with incident issue management. agent-accuracy-report.yml integrates scripts/accuracy-report.js via mongosh with satisfaction threshold alerting.
